s1.title: 1. Service description
s1.body: Instrumental Separator is an application that runs entirely in your browser and uses an AI model (demucs-web) to split an audio file into its vocal and instrumental components. The audio file you upload is never sent to any server — all processing happens locally, on your device.

s2.title: 2. User responsibility regarding copyright
s2.body1: By using this application, you take full responsibility for the audio files you upload, process, play, or download. It is your sole responsibility to ensure you hold the necessary rights to the content, or that you have legal permission to process it (for example: your own content, public-domain content, or content covered by an appropriate license).
s2.body2: The application does not and cannot verify the copyright status of uploaded files. The developer/operator of the application assumes no liability for any copyright infringement, claims, takedown notices, litigation, or other legal disputes that may arise from using the application on copyright-protected content without proper authorization. Any such consequences fall exclusively on the user who uploaded the file.

s3.title: 3. No warranties
s3.body: The application is provided "as is", without any express or implied warranty regarding the accuracy, quality, or completeness of the audio separation results.

s4.title: 4. Limitation of liability
s4.body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, the developer/operator of the application shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or other damages resulting from the use or inability to use the application, including but not limited to consequences related to copyright.

s5.title: 5. Acceptance of terms
s5.body: By checking the consent box and using the audio separation feature, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to these Terms & Conditions in their entirety.

s6.title: 6. Cookies and local storage
s6.body1: This application does not use traditional cookies. We only use your browser's local storage (localStorage), which stays on your device and is never sent to a server:
s6.item1: Language preference and cookie choice — strictly necessary for the app to work.
s6.item2: Vercel Web Analytics (optional, only if you accept) — anonymous, aggregated visit statistics (pages viewed, approximate country). It uses no cookies, builds no profile of you, and collects no personally identifiable data.
s6.body2: You can change your analytics choice at any time from the “Cookie settings” link in the page footer.
